note: AD-138: the workers a workplace takes on its own, by the level it is kept at (I..VI). A type not named here takes one. The farm is FarmField.farmers (AD-130, with its legacy rule), not listed. livestock: one keeper for one or two pens, two for four, one again at VI (the machine feeds and the wolves cull; the keeper shears and brings in new stock). AD-139 restaurant: its own trade (workers: the cook, a baker) one at I..V and none at VI (the kitchen machine cooks), and its couriers (porter) 0/0/0/1/2/2; a row of that shape names the other trades a workplace posts besides its own. kennel_annex (AD-138 IV): equipment, nobody works there. clinic (AD-152): one medic, two from IV (they visit the sick at home), none at VI (everyone is healed without medics). smithy (AD-155): one smith, none at VI (the bench turns by itself). AD-147 warehouse: its couriers (its own trade, porters) 1/1/1/2/2/2; at VI none while the village's harnessed wolves carry and no courier holds a load (CartWolves.relieved).
